```{css}
.wrapper {
  color: black;
  background-color: white;
  /*border: 1px dashed grey; /*Only need if cutting out ourselves */
  text-align: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: center center;
  background-size: cover;
  border-bottom: 50px solid #e59a91;
}

[slot="name"] {
  font-weight: normal;
  font-size: 40px;
  margin: 0 0 0 0;
  position: relative;
  top: 2em;
}

[slot="title"] {
  font-weight: normal;
  font-size: 40px;
  margin: 0 0 0 0;
  position: relative;
  top: 2.2em;
}

[slot="email"]  {
  font-weight: normal;
  font-size: 25px;
  color: black;
  margin: 0 0 0 0;
  position: relative;
  top: 3.2em;
}

[slot="url"] {
  font-weight: normal;
  font-size: 25px;
  padding-top: 0em;
  color: black;
  margin: 0 0 0 0;
  position: relative;
  top: 5.5em;
}

.logo {
  height: 10%;
  float: left;
  margin-left: 10px;
  margin-top: -20px;
  position: absolute;
}

.page {
  margin: 0in;
}
```
